summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.1 (Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package) — run 6 plans across 5 waves to wire the new SDK packages into the web app, replacing direct service calls.
summary.outcome: Plans 01-04 executed successfully via subagents. Plan 05 (rewire web app hooks to SDK) required extensive manual debugging — 7 atomic bug fixes applied, bringing 9/10 core filesystem operations working. Plan 06 (cleanup/release) not yet executed. Bin delete-to-bin remains broken.

repo: The api-client package requires explicit setApiClientConfig() initialization before any generated IPNS/API functions work — this was never wired up in the web app, causing silent failures on all SDK IPNS operations.

The web app uses a dual-path architecture where folder CRUD goes through the SDK but file upload/download used the old service chain — this created irreconcilable IPNS sequence number conflicts (409s) that could not be resolved with a bridge/sync layer.
SDK-created folders store the child entry with a UUID id (from FolderEntry), but the initial handleCreate implementation used ipnsName as the store id, breaking folder navigation after creation.

The old upload service (useDropUpload → upload.service) and SDK write to the same IPNS records independently, making stale sequence numbers inevitable — dual-path must be eliminated entirely, not bridged.
initializeBin() (old service) runs async during login; SDK loadBin() fired before bin IPNS record existed, causing SDK bin state to fail silently and fall back to hard delete.
The playwright E2E test suite has page objects under tests/e2e/page-objects/ with subdirectories for dialogs and file-browser — existing helpers cover login, context menu, rename dialog, move dialog.
The API has a TEST_LOGIN_SECRET env var that allows passwordless test authentication, avoiding OTP flows in automated tests.
pnpm dev runs all apps; the API writes DEV OTP logs that can be read from the background task output file.

code.finding: setApiClientConfig() must be called here after SDK client is created, before any folder/IPNS operations run. Also loadBin() must be called after the old initializeBin() service completes, not immediately on SDK init.

ensureFolderRegistered was over-engineered — attempts to sync children/seqNum/privateKey between old store and SDK created cascading edge cases. Simplified to: skip registration if SDK already has the folder.

createFolder must return the FolderEntry UUID (child id) alongside ipnsName so the store can use the correct identifier for lookup. Added downloadFromIpns() and getFolderState() convenience methods for web app consumers.
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish needs 409 conflict retry — re-resolves current IPNS sequence number on conflict and retries once. Without this, any stale seq number causes permanent failure.
Rewired from two-step service (upload.service → useFileOperations.addFiles) to client.uploadFile() which handles encrypt+upload+IPNS atomically. Eliminates dual-writer IPNS conflict.
Rewired from old ipns.service → file-metadata.service chain to client.downloadFromIpns(). Old chain used different IPNS resolution path causing decryption failures on SDK-uploaded files.
Also used old download service directly — rewired to client.downloadFromIpns() to fix 'decryption failed' on text edit.

workflow: When a phase branch has stale/bad implementation, reset to latest main before re-executing rather than trying to amend — clean slate avoids compound issues.
Playwright MCP can drive headed browser sessions for UI verification without writing test scripts — more flexible for exploratory debugging.
Integration tests at the SDK level (vitest, hitting real API) are faster to write and more reliable than E2E Playwright tests for verifying crypto/IPNS operations.
Atomic commits per logical fix (even within the same file) make the session's debugging work reviewable and revertable.
The user preference is: don't ask for manual verification — drive it yourself via Playwright or integration tests.

friction: First wave execution was interrupted mid-run because user was unhappy with Plan 02 decisions made in a previous session — required branch reset and full re-execution.
The ensureFolderRegistered bridge approach was attempted 5+ times with different strategies before determining the correct fix was eliminating the dual-path entirely.
Playwright E2E file upload requires injecting DataTransfer via page.evaluate() — no direct file upload API in Playwright MCP, required workaround with hidden input.
Background task notifications arrived for stale/earlier runs during active debugging, creating noise about which results were current.
SDK integration test runner couldn't resolve workspace packages via ts-node — had to use the package's vitest config instead.
The user had to prompt explicitly that they don't want to be asked to manually verify things — the assistant kept deferring verification to the user.
409 IPNS conflicts during E2E tests were initially misdiagnosed as test infrastructure issues rather than real sequence number bugs.
open_items: Bin delete-to-bin is broken: SDK loadBin() fails to load existing bin IPNS state (timing issue with old initializeBin service) — falls back to hard delete silently.
Plan 19.1-06 (final cleanup, imports, release config) has not been executed yet.
useFileUpload (the split-step chunked upload hook) and useFileDelete were intentionally NOT rewired to SDK in Plan 05 due to architectural differences — still on old service path.
Pre-existing DTS circular dependency between @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/crypto causes pnpm -r run build to fail (though per-package builds work).
The sdk-debug.spec.ts E2E test file created during debugging should be cleaned up or promoted to a real test before merge.
The integration.test.ts created in packages/sdk/src/__tests__/ should be reviewed for inclusion in the test suite.
Phase verification (gsd-verifier) has not been run yet — phase is not marked complete in ROADMAP.md/STATE.md.
